# Named owner or landfill

`customer_support.heu.queue_management.named_owner_or_landfill` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> A queue nobody owns by name accumulates rather than flows.


## The heuristic

**A queue nobody owns by name accumulates rather than flows.**


_Why:_ Shared ownership of a queue means nobody is embarrassed by its oldest item, and embarrassment is the mechanism by which aged work gets picked up at all.
